page.overview:
What is Alliances?

The Alliances comic was a planned but unreleased comic by ARMADA, a division of Acclaim Comics. This comic continues the story of Jaeuhl Carthalion and his wife Kaysa after the casting of the World Spell, as seen in the Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering comic.

! Title !! Author !! Publishing date !! Set !! Setting (plane) !! Featuring

Alliances has arrived! Across the world of Dominaria, the great Ice Age draws to its inexorable conclusion. Storms and flooding plague the land, and frost is replaced by mud. Those that survived the cold must now forge alliances to face the dark legacy of the wizards who had been trapped there for so long.

Return to besieged Terisiare, where the druid Kaysa has grown up to fall in love with none other than that wayward Knight of Kjeldor, Jaeuhl Carthalion! But has this elven juvenile delinquent truly grown up? What becomes of this star-crossed couple in the twilight of Dominaria's endless winter?
